name: rwrife/foldermatch
description: Cross-platform folder compare & one-way/two-way sync for Windows 10/11 & macOS — diff two folders (size/date/content hash), preview adds/updates/deletes/conflicts, then mirror/sync safely with dry-run + undo. Optional local-AI change summaries via Ollama/llama.cpp tiny models. Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/tunetag
description: Cross-platform desktop music tag editor for Windows 10/11 & macOS — batch-edit ID3/Vorbis/MP4 tags, embed album art, rename files from tags, with optional local-AI auto-tagging (Ollama/llama.cpp tiny models). Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/metawipe
description: Privacy-first metadata viewer & scrubber for Windows & macOS — inspect and strip EXIF/GPS/XMP/IPTC from photos, plus PDF & Office document metadata, before you share. Batch clean with optional local-AI sensitive-data detection. Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/fontloom
description: Cross-platform desktop font manager & previewer for Windows and macOS — browse, preview, compare, tag & organize fonts, with optional local-AI font pairing. Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/pixel-press
description: Windows batch image resizer, converter & optimizer — bulk resize, convert (JPG/PNG/WebP/AVIF), compress, watermark & rename with live preview and optional local-AI smart crop. Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/markup-shot
description: Windows screenshot annotation & markup — capture or open an image, add arrows/boxes/text/highlight/blur/step-numbers, then copy or save. Optional local-AI auto-redaction. Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/diskscape
description: Windows disk-space visualizer — fast folder scan with interactive treemap/sunburst to find what's eating your drive, drill down, and clean up. Optional local-AI cleanup suggestions. Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/dupe-sweeper
description: Local duplicate-file finder & cleaner for Windows — scan folders/drives, group exact duplicates by content hash plus optional near-duplicate image detection (perceptual hash + optional local-AI), preview groups, and safely delete/move/hardlink with one-click undo. Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/rename-ranger
description: Batch file renamer for Windows — regex/pattern rules, sequential numbering, EXIF/date tokens, live preview & undo, with optional local-AI smart naming. Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/snip-text
description: Windows region-capture OCR — snip any part of your screen and instantly grab editable text to your clipboard. Offline by default, optional local-AI vision for tough layouts & handwriting. Privacy-first.

name: rwrife/clip-scribe
description: Windows clipboard history manager — searchable clip history, pinned favorites & snippets, with optional local-AI text transforms (Ollama/llama.cpp tiny models). Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/snapdex
description: Local photo indexer & semantic search for Windows — index your library, search by filename/EXIF/date, plus optional local-AI visual search (CLIP / MiniCPM-V tiny models via Ollama/llama.cpp). Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/file-lantern
description: Local file indexer & instant search for Windows — lightning-fast filename and full-text search across your drives, with optional local-AI natural-language queries. Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/gridquill
description: Windows desktop spreadsheet-style editor for Markdown tables — edit in a familiar grid, auto-align columns, import/export CSV, with optional local-AI table generation & cleanup. Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/markquill
description: Distraction-free Windows markdown authoring suite — live preview, snippets, and optional local-AI writing assist. Offline & privacy-first.

name: rwrife/swatch-snap
description: Windows screen color picker & palette assistant — eyedrop any pixel, build/export palettes, with optional local-AI palette naming. Privacy-first, offline by default.
